text: I stand on the threshold of a glass-walled room, looking in on a bright, colorful exhibition space. The scene inside is boldly marked with "R+D"—a space devoted to research, innovation, and development. Screens glow with information and possibilities. I feel curious and invigorated, aware of the energy of ideas in the air. I’m drawn to the promise of discovery, but there’s also a faint trepidation: what will I learn when I step inside? Am I merely an observer, or about to become part of an unfolding experiment?
